NAME: Spoofing of extravehicular navigation and pedestrian data
DESCRIPTION: An attacker injects falsified road maps or phantom pedestrian data via the V2XT TO V2XM flow, potentially triggering unintended emergency braking or other hazardous vehicle responses.

NAME: Spoofing of vehicle dynamics metrics (speed, steering)
DESCRIPTION: Logical tampering or sensor spoofing injects falsified telemetry (e.g., speed, steering angle) into the DS TO DECU flow, causing main AI models to make decisions based on artificial vehicle states.

NAME: Tampering with AI model aggregation and elaboration
DESCRIPTION: An attacker compromises the Main ECU to alter the AI models responsible for aggregating sensor inputs and elaborating information, leading to incorrect system outputs.

NAME: Tampering with world-locked virtual frame generation
DESCRIPTION: Attackers modify the virtual frames transmitted over the ARDC TO AROD flow, deliberately misaligning the AR overlay with the physical road and causing dangerous navigational misjudgments.

NAME: Repudiation of diagnostic signals sent to internal ECUs
DESCRIPTION: Due to a lack of cryptographic signatures on internal flows like MECU TO DECU, unauthorized commands or diagnostic signals can be issued without accountability or traceability.

NAME: Repudiation of outgoing vehicle navigation broadcasts
DESCRIPTION: The vehicle broadcasts navigation or status information via the V2XM TO V2XT flow without sufficient proof of origin, allowing malicious entities to deny sending hazardous messages.

NAME: Information disclosure of driver psychological state monitoring
DESCRIPTION: Unauthorized interception of the CS TO CPECU video or sensor feeds results in the compromise of highly sensitive biometric and psychological driver data.

NAME: Information disclosure of internal unencrypted sensor telemetry
DESCRIPTION: Eavesdropping on the unencrypted DECU TO MECU interface allows attackers to passively gather critical vehicle dynamics telemetry.

NAME: Denial of Service (DoS) disrupting extravehicular communication
DESCRIPTION: Attackers overwhelm the V2X Module with malicious traffic, disrupting the vehicle's ability to communicate with targets such as infrastructure, cloud systems, and other vehicles.

NAME: DoS on the Picture Generation Unit (PGU) blocking ADAS visualization
DESCRIPTION: Resource exhaustion or network flooding targeting the AR Output Device (PGU) blinds the driver to necessary AR visualizations and ADAS content.

NAME: Elevation of Privilege through malicious over-the-air payload
DESCRIPTION: A malicious payload delivered via the V2XT TO V2XM external interface exploits parsing vulnerabilities in the V2X Module, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code and gain unauthorized access.

NAME: Elevation of Privilege via unauthorized cross-ECU code execution
DESCRIPTION: An attacker successfully compromises a lower-privileged ECU and uses internal interfaces to pivot and execute unauthorized code on the critical Main ECU.
